A0169.title: Telegram Official Verification
A0169.description: Identify genuine bots and communities by monitoring and collecting Telegram official verification badges, usernames, channel/group identifiers, and other features, combined with whitelist matching and signature verification to determine account and community authenticity, thereby detecting phishing and impersonation accounts.

references.title: Telegram Has a New Verification Strategy to Cut Down on Scams

A0169.definition: Use Telegram official verification badges to identify authentic bots and communities, avoiding phishing.
A0169.limitation: Verification badges are only effective when users actively inspect them; automated scripts and elderly users are easily deceived by look-alike usernames and forged screenshots. Unverified genuine accounts cannot be distinguished, and legitimate accounts with similar names are prone to be misjudged as impersonation.
